messages:
Eden Park: Morning! I'm Eden — joined Eng Platform today. Based in Berlin, moved from Seoul. I shoot night skies and babysit a tiny succulent squad (Nova = leader). Who wants rooftop pancakes Friday 10am? Also which mug color should I grab: black / forest-green / galaxy-blue?
Maya Sato: Welcome Eden! I'm in for pancakes. black mug pls :coffee:
Luca Park: welcome!! galaxy-blue FTW. show us a Milky Way pic sometime :milky_way:
Priya Shah: Hi Eden — rooftop is the west terrace by the coffee station. I'll put up a sticky sign. @facilities can confirm?
Noor Khan: i'll bring maple syrup and a tiny spatula :pancakes:
Sam Pizza: count me in. split black for hot, green for cold drinks :ok_hand:
Arjun Patel: FYI there's a plug by the pantry for an amp. we have a record-exchange shelf if you wanna leave a vinyl :record:
welcome-bot: Eden Park added to #new-hires. Please reply with hoodie size to claim swag.
Eden Park: Hoodie M, thanks! I'll bring roasted barley tea and a Jóhann vinyl. remote folks — want a pancake care package delivery option? :thinking_face:
Maya Sato: please yes for remote care package :pleading_face:
Priya Shah: I'll coordinate shipping labels. Also quick heads-up: masks still in pantry if anyone wants.
Sam Pizza: reaction :heart: — welcome again Eden!
Eden Park: <3 excited to meet you all and swap records!
